title: Inter at Bologna without Pavard: strain confirmed, 20 days reported
description:
Inter are down two starters and play at Bologna today — no excuses.
https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=46

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

CONFIRMED · Inter.it (Oct 16): Benjamin Pavard has a strain in the adductor muscles of his right thigh. No return date given.
CONFIRMED · Inter.it (Oct 16): Cristian Chivu says Lautaro Martínez will probably be back after the November break.
REPORTED · FCInterNews (Oct 16): Pavard faces a layoff of at least 20 days. Inter have published no timeline.
REPORTED · Sky Sport Italia and Gazzetta dello Sport (Oct 16): the papers still disagree over whether Francesco Pio Esposito or Ange-Yoan Bonny starts beside Marcus Thuram.

Today at Bologna: 12:00 PM ET · 18:00 CEST · Serie A matchday 7.
